# EdgeCompute Solutions Q4 2024 Earnings Report

## Executive Summary

EdgeCompute Solutions delivered exceptional financial performance in 2024, reporting record revenue of $4.29 million, representing a robust 38.3% year-over-year growth from $3.10 million in the prior year. The company achieved strong profitability with net income of $605,829 and maintained healthy operating margins of 14.1%, demonstrating effective cost management while scaling operations. With a lean workforce of 146 employees, EdgeCompute generated approximately $29,300 in revenue per employee, reflecting the high-value nature of our specialized financial technology solutions and operational efficiency gains from our scalable platform architecture.

## Revenue and Profitability Analysis

The company's impressive 38.3% revenue growth was driven by increased adoption of our integrated financial technology suite across mid-market and enterprise clients. Our focus on recurring revenue models and long-term client partnerships contributed to revenue stability and predictable cash flows throughout the year. The 14.1% operating margin reflects our disciplined approach to expense management while continuing to invest in product development and client success initiatives. Net income of $605,829 represents a healthy 14.1% net margin, positioning EdgeCompute favorably within the financial technology sector where margins typically range from 10-20% for companies of similar scale and market focus.

## Business Segment Performance

Our core product portfolio demonstrated strong market traction across all three key offerings within the finance sector. The Trading System platform continued to be our flagship revenue driver, benefiting from increased market volatility and growing demand for low-latency execution capabilities among institutional clients. Portfolio Management solutions saw accelerated adoption as asset managers sought more sophisticated risk-adjusted return optimization tools, while our Risk Analytics platform gained significant momentum with regulatory-driven demand for enhanced stress testing and compliance reporting capabilities. The concentrated focus on the finance vertical allowed EdgeCompute to deepen domain expertise and deliver increasingly specialized solutions that command premium pricing and foster strong client retention.

## Forward-Looking Guidance

Looking ahead to 2025, EdgeCompute Solutions is well-positioned to sustain strong growth momentum, with management targeting revenue growth in the 25-35% range as we expand our client base and introduce enhanced AI-driven analytics capabilities across our product suite. The company plans to strategically increase headcount by approximately 20% to support scaling operations and accelerate product innovation, while maintaining operating margins in the 12-15% range. Key growth initiatives include expanding our addressable market through strategic partnerships with financial services integrators, launching our next-generation cloud-native platform, and exploring adjacent market opportunities in insurance and wealth management sectors where our core competencies can drive similar value propositions.
